usageNotes: Use this endpoint to modify an existing node-level firewall rule at a specific position, or to reorder it using the `moveto` parameter (when `moveto` is supplied, all other field arguments are ignored). The caller must hold `Sys.Modify` on `/nodes/{node}`. Pass the `digest` from a prior GET to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.

examples.summary: Disable a rule at position 2 and add a comment

tips: Use `moveto` alone to reorder a rule without changing its content — other body fields are silently ignored when `moveto` is present.
Use the `delete` field (comma-separated config key names) to unset individual rule properties like `dest` or `dport` without rewriting the whole rule.
The `enable` field is an integer: 1 = enabled, 0 = disabled. Omitting it leaves the current value unchanged.
Rule positions are zero-indexed; verify the current position with GET /nodes/{node}/firewall/rules before updating.
Changes take effect immediately in the running firewall — no reload command is needed, but verify with GET after PUT since the call returns null.
